risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively transparent and quantitatively detailed, particularly regarding credit losses, allowances, revenue growth, inventory constraints, and finance-receivable expansion. It highlights material exposure to subprime borrower performance, elevated used-vehicle costs, liquidity needs, and normalization of credit losses, while offsetting these concerns with descriptions of underwriting and collection controls. Repeated discussion of macroeconomic and vehicle-supply factors adds some boilerplate and limits specificity regarding forward outcomes.
